title: Multi-view Semantic-aware Resource Allocation for Edge AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.34532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communication is emerging as a pivotal paradigm to overcome wireless resource scarcity in 6G networks. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end framework for semantics-aware resource allocation in multi-user Edge AI. We extend the Opportunistic Information Bottleneck (OIB) to a multi-view setting, termed the Multi-view Gaussian Information Bottleneck (MGIB), by fusing complementary source views without variational approximation or network retraining. A resource allocation framework is then formulated for joint compression-level selection, transmission mode selection (i.e., the number of active sources per group), and PRB assignment. The problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP), solved efficiently via a proposed Lagrangian Relaxation (LR) algorithm, and benchmarked against the NP-hard optimal solution. translated_title: 面向边缘AI的多视图语义感知资源分配
translated_abstract: 语义通信正成为克服6G网络中无线资源稀缺问题的关键范式。本文提出了一种新颖的端到端框架，用于多用户边缘AI中的语义感知资源分配。我们将机会信息瓶颈（OIB）扩展到多视图场景，称为多视图高斯信息瓶颈（MGIB），通过融合互补的源视图，无需变分近似或网络重训练。随后构建了一个资源分配框架，联合进行压缩级别选择、传输模式选择（即每组中活跃源的数量）以及物理资源块（PRB）分配。该问题被建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），通过提出的拉格朗日松弛（LR）算法高效求解，并与NP难的最优解进行对比基准测试。仿真结果表明，所提出的LR方案实现了接近最优的效用，并使PRB效率翻倍。
tldr: 本文提出多视图高斯信息瓶颈（MGIB）及基于拉格朗日松弛的资源分配算法，在多用户边缘AI中实现接近最优的语义感知联合资源分配，使物理资源块效率翻倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-view Gaussian Information Bottleneck (MGIB) and a Lagrangian Relaxation-based allocation algorithm to achieve near-optimal semantics-aware joint resource allocation in multi-user Edge AI, doubling PRB efficiency.
